verdict.rationale: CockroachDB advertises PostgreSQL wire-protocol compatibility, implying general compatibility with Postgres-based ORMs/drivers, but the evidence pack contains no documented, ORM-specific guides (Prisma, Drizzle, Django, Rails) and one community report notes incompatibilities (missing array columns) that break real-world Postgres-client usage. missing for 10: dedicated official guides for Prisma, Drizzle, Django, and Rails integration, and confirmation that ORM-specific features work without workarounds.
